items.source: This annotation can be used to define either custom conversions for single attributes by specifying a custom Neo4jPersistentPropertyConverter and if needed, a custom factory to create that converter or the annotation can be used to build custom meta-annotated annotations like @org.springframework.data.neo4j.core.support.DateLong.
items.translation: 此注解可用于为单个属性定义自定义转换，方法是指定一个自定义的Neo4jPersistentPropertyConverter接口，并在需要时指定一个用于创建该转换器工厂；或者，此注解也可用于构建自定义的元注解，例如@org.springframework.data.neo4j.core.support.DateLong。

items.source: This service orchestrates a standard Spring conversion service with Neo4jConversions registered.
items.translation: 该服务编排了一个标准的 Spring 转换服务，并注册了 Neo4jConversions。

items.source: This interface represents a pair of methods capable of converting values of type T to and from values.
items.translation: 该接口表示一对方法，能够将类型为 `T` 的值转换为 `values`，并将其从 `values` 转换回来。

items.source: This interface needs to be implemented to provide custom configuration for a Neo4jPersistentPropertyConverter.
items.translation: 需要实现此接口，以便为 Neo4jPersistentPropertyConverter 提供自定义配置。

items.source:
<!-- tag::intent[] --> Provides a set of simples types that SDN supports. The
`Neo4jConversions` allows bringing in additional, custom converters. <!-- end::intent[]
-->
items.translation: <!-- tag::intent[] --> 提供了一组 SDN 支持的简单类型。`Neo4jConversions` 允许引入额外的自定义转换器。<!-- end::intent[] -->

items.source:
This package contains the core infrastructure for creating an
imperative or reactive client that can execute queries.
items.translation: 该包提供了创建可执行查询的指令式或响应式客户端的核心基础设施。

items.source:
This package contains the schema that is defined by a set of classes, representing
nodes and relationships and their properties.
items.translation: 该包包含由一组类定义的架构，这些类表示节点、关系及其属性。

items.source:
This package provides a couple of support classes that might be
helpful in your domain, for example a predicate indicating that some transaction may be
retried and additional converters and id generators.
items.translation: 该包提供了一些可能对您领域有帮助的支持类，例如指示某些事务可重试的谓词，以及额外的转换器和 ID 生成器。

items.source:
Contains the core infrastructure for translating unmanaged Neo4j
transaction into Spring managed transactions.
items.translation: 包含将未管理的 Neo4j 事务转换为 Spring 管理事务的核心基础设施。

items.source:
Manages all build-in Neo4j conversions: Cypher types, some additional types and the
shared set of Spring Data and Neo4j spatial types.
items.translation: 管理所有内置的 Neo4j 类型转换：Cypher 类型、一些附加类型以及 Spring Data 和 Neo4j 空间类型的共享集合。

items.source:
You need to provide an implementation of this interface in case you want to store a
property of an entity as separate properties on a node.
items.translation: 如果您希望将实体的属性作为节点的独立属性进行存储，则需要提供该接口的实现。

items.source: A list of Neo4j simple types: All attributes that can be mapped to a property.
items.translation: Neo4j 简单类型列表：所有可映射为属性的属性。
